legendary.name: Sheaf of the Long Summer
legendary.flavour: Bound on the last warm evening of a year that never turned cold.

legendary.name: Millwind Vane
legendary.flavour: Goldmill's oldest sails. They turn even when the air stands still.

legendary.name: Everwarm Anvil
legendary.flavour: Its face has not cooled since the first bar was struck on it.

legendary.name: Cogheart of the Ninth Shaft
legendary.flavour: Wound once by a dwarf long buried. It has not slipped a tooth since.

legendary.name: Tidecall Conch
legendary.flavour: Hold it to your ear and the harbour tells you where the shoals are.

legendary.name: Harbour Stormglass
legendary.flavour: The water inside rises an hour before the weather does.

legendary.name: Elder Acorn
legendary.flavour: Fell from the first tree of Tallwood. It is still deciding what to be.

legendary.name: Stagcall Horn
legendary.flavour: One note, and every elite in the wood turns to look.

legendary.name: Codex of Unwritten Pages
legendary.flavour: Each page fills itself the moment someone in the room learns it.

legendary.name: Seventh-Circle Prism
legendary.flavour: Cut by six masters. The seventh cut is the light it lets out.

legendary.name: Skrix's Pilfered Lantern
legendary.flavour: Whoever owned this light first, it still burns for them.

legendary.name: Jawbone Lyre
legendary.flavour: Strung with gut and grudges. Its song makes axes heavier.

legendary.name: Rimeheart
legendary.flavour: Hessa froze her own heart to outlive her enemies. It worked.

legendary.name: Unquenched Candle
legendary.flavour: Wax that never runs short, lit from a flame that never went out.

legendary.name: Crown of the Ossuary
legendary.flavour: Every bone in it once knelt to him. Some still do.

legendary.name: Velvet Thirst Chalice
legendary.flavour: Never empty, and never quite the colour of wine.

legendary.name: Ember Prince's Grasp
legendary.flavour: A cooling coal in an iron fist. It never finishes cooling.

legendary.name: Hoard-Sleeper's Egg
legendary.flavour: Warm as a coin left in the sun. Something inside is counting.

legendary.name: Silk Widow's Spindle
legendary.flavour: Spun from the threads her prey pulled loose escaping.

legendary.name: Golden Hive Comb
legendary.flavour: The honey keeps the queen's hours: every idle hand fills a cell.

legendary.name: The Seventeenth Key
legendary.flavour: It opens no door any more. It only keeps the line.

legendary.name: Bramble Queen's Rose
legendary.flavour: Pick it and it picks you back.

legendary.name: The Tidewake Bell
legendary.flavour: It rang for every burial. Underwater, it rings for the ones who stayed.

legendary.name: Heart of the Last Pour
legendary.flavour: The foundry's final casting never cooled. It beats at forge heat.

legendary.name: Amber of the Sleeping Queen
legendary.flavour: A queen no bigger than a thumbnail, waiting for her hive to call.

legendary.name: The Rimebitten Horn
legendary.flavour: Blown once to warn the pass. The echo froze before it came back.

legendary.name: The Drowned Concordance
legendary.flavour: Every page is ruined. Read it anyway: the ink rearranges itself.

legendary.name: Fang of the Coiled Wyrm
legendary.flavour: Pried from the skull on the spire. It hums when storms gather.

legendary.name: Oathbreaker
legendary.flavour: Snapped on the day he broke his word. It mended. He did not.

legendary.name: Labyrinth Cleaver
legendary.flavour: Gorrath never found the maze's exit. He made a few.

legendary.name: Stormwing Staff
legendary.flavour: A wing-claw of the Storm Wing, still holding its last lightning.

legendary.name: Moonwane Scepter
legendary.flavour: The Countess held court only on nights it shone.

legendary.name: Bridgewarden's Maul
legendary.flavour: A keystone of the bridge he kept. Nobody crossed after him.

legendary.name: Vigil Censer
legendary.flavour: Its smoke smells of a chapel that burned three hundred years ago.

legendary.name: Pale Duelist's Coat
legendary.flavour: Cut to move in. Not one stitch of it was ever torn.

legendary.name: Coldscale Hauberk
legendary.flavour: Shed scales from a marsh that never thaws.

legendary.name: Veil of the Regent
legendary.flavour: She ruled from behind it for a century after she died.

legendary.name: Gravewake Mattock
legendary.flavour: Dug four hundred graves and struck ore in every one.

legendary.name: Sunken-Deck Harpoon
legendary.flavour: Barnacled, rusted, and still the best catch on the coast.

legendary.name: Blightmoon Sickle
legendary.flavour: Rotroot's last harvest: everything it cut grew back twice.

legendary.name: Lens of the Last Keeper
legendary.flavour: Ground for a lamp that went dark a hundred years ago. It still gathers every stray spark.

legendary.name: The Coral Compass
legendary.flavour: Its needle is a living polyp, and it always points the short way out.

legendary.name: The Smugglers' Doubloon
legendary.flavour: Bitten by every captain who ever held it, and still paying.

legendary.name: Seed of the Drowned Oak
legendary.flavour: It sprouts in salt water and teaches patience to whoever carries it.

legendary.name: The Boiler-Heart Governor
legendary.flavour: Spin it once and every engine in the room runs a little truer.

legendary.name: The Silver Moon Rosary
legendary.flavour: Each bead was blessed under a full moon; the night-born flinch at its click.

legendary.name: The Thunderhead Ingot
legendary.flavour: Cast in a lightning strike. It still crackles when a blow lands true.

legendary.name: Tidecrown of the Deep
legendary.flavour: Worn by the thing beneath the gate. The kings of the deep bow to whoever wears it now.

legendary.name: Ondrel's Storm Lantern
legendary.flavour: It burns brighter the worse the weather, and never needs oil.

legendary.name: The Coralhorn
legendary.flavour: Hathra shed it in the maze. The walls have grown around its echo ever since.

legendary.name: The Tide Broker's Ledger
legendary.flavour: Every debt in the isles is written here, and every one comes due.

legendary.name: Morwen's Moon-Bell
legendary.flavour: Rung once for vespers and once for the hunt. Nobody remembers which came first.

legendary.name: The Abyssal Pearl
legendary.flavour: It took the deep a thousand years to make. It takes it one breath to give things back.

legendary.name: Brackenmere's Bough-Axe
legendary.flavour: Cut from the oak's own limb. It never dulls on wood it loves.

legendary.name: The Boiler-Rune Chisel
legendary.flavour: Its edge is hot enough to write on stone like wax.

legendary.name: The Stormsmith's Hammer
legendary.flavour: Thundergut forged storms with it. Now it forges whoever swings it.
